prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents damage along the right rear quarter panel and rear door, consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. The scraped paint, creased sheet metal and cracked taillight lens line up with the contact pattern described by the parties. Repair will involve replacing the taillight assembly, straightening and refinishing the rear door, and blending the adjacent quarter panel. The labor hours requested fit the extent of this damage. Records reviewed show no repeated charges, and nothing in the file indicates earlier damage to this vehicle. The estimate is recommended for approval as written.
